author: Alex Michaelides
synopsis:
Alicia Berenson appears to have an idyllic existence. As a celebrated artist wedded to a successful fashion photographer, she resides in a luxurious London residence featuring expansive views of a park. Late one night, after Gabriel comes home from a photo shoot, Alicia fires five bullets into his face and subsequently lapses into total silence, never uttering another word.

Her steadfast refusal to speak or justify her actions transforms a private calamity into a massive public obsession, propelling Alicia into infamous celebrity. Consequently, the value of her paintings surges dramatically, while the mute woman herself is tucked away from prying reporters inside the Grove, a high-security psychiatric facility in North London.

Theo Faber, a forensic psychotherapist, has spent years yearning for the chance to treat Alicia. His relentless pursuit to break her silence and solve the puzzle behind the murder leads him on a winding journey that exposes his own hidden drives—an obsessive quest for the truth that risks consuming his entire life.
title: The Silent Patient
